titles.title: Catching the CEO by the Tail
If You Step on the CEO's Tail

description:
“You are the first human in 200 years to smell my scent and still keep her sanity.” 

Beom Taehun is the CEO of the architectural firm [In] and an idol-like figure in the world of architecture. Although he seems perfect, he hides an extraordinary secret: he is actually a Sangun —a lord of the mountain—, a tiger who has lived for two hundred years. Just as Taehun is on the verge of losing control due to the arrival of his rut, Iseol, his straightforward and determined secretary who has long been in love with him, enters his office trembling.     
“If I have to watch you marry another woman, I would rather be devoured by you and end it all.” 

That single sentence snaps the last thread of his self-control. On a night of torrential rain, the door to the CEO’s office locks… and the tiger’s long, intense feast begins.
